Deltarune

A role-playing game by Toby Fox that follows a group of characters through mysterious worlds, combining exploration, dialogue, and patterned battles.

  • Games
  • Fandoms
  • Storytelling

Context

Deltarune has connections to Undertale through familiar faces and ideas. Its official FAQ describes its setting as a different world.

The game uses a party of characters, music, humor, and encounters that give players decisions about how to proceed.

Examples

  • A battle can ask the party to coordinate actions while the player dodges incoming patterns.
